app.navigation.description: The name of the app's main navigation (the places: home, notifications, search, profile, settings), for assistive technology.

app.home.description: The place of the navigation, and the heading of its screen, that shows the home timeline (the posts of the accounts the reader follows).

app.notifications.description: The place of the navigation that shows the reader's notifications.

app.search.description: The place of the navigation that searches posts, accounts and hashtags.

app.profile.description: The place of the navigation that shows the reader's own profile.

app.settings.description: The place of the navigation that shows the reader's settings.

app.compose.description: The primary action of the app, under the logo or floating over the navigation, that starts writing a post; also its keyboard shortcut in the keyboard shortcuts dialog.

app.around.description: The name of the column beside the timeline on wide screens, which shows what is happening around the reader (their server, later their notifications), for assistive technology.

app.about.defaultMessage: このサーバーについて
app.about.description: The heading of the section of the column beside the timeline that names the server the reader is on; it links to the server's about page.

app.signed_out.defaultMessage: ログインすると、ホームタイムラインが表示されます。
app.signed_out.description: In place of the home timeline when the browser is not signed in; a link to the sign-in page follows it.

app.sign_in.description: The link after the line that asks a reader who is not signed in to sign in; it opens the server's sign-in page.

app.sign_in_failed.defaultMessage: ログインを完了できませんでした。もう一度試してください。
app.sign_in_failed.description: In place of the home timeline when the sign-in came back to the app but could not finish (an old or second tab, the server refused it); a link to sign in again follows it.

app.not_found.defaultMessage: ここにはまだ何もありません。
app.not_found.description: The heading of the screen at an address the app has no screen for, such as a place of the navigation that is not built yet.
